main.description: Who maintains a scope: its publishers, who create packages in it and start as owners of each, and its owners, who also change the scope, its policy and profile, and any of its packages' maintainers records. A change counts once the previous record's 'ownerThreshold' of owners have attested it.

ownerThreshold.description: How many owners must attest a change to the scope's maintainers, policy or organization, or to one of its packages' maintainers records.
